studies.title: The spoked-wheel chariot
studies.caption: Herders of the Ural steppe build light chariots on spoked wheels, drawn by horses.
studies.prompt: Low three-quarter view of a light wooden two-wheeled chariot on the Ural steppe about1900BCE, two small sturdy horses harnessed side by side, focus on thin spokes and rawhide lashings; a handler checks a wheel. No iron tires, Roman racing body or medieval harness.
